!doctype.title: <!doctype>
!doctype.history: <>!DOCTYPE html> is used to specify that the document is an HTML5 document. It helps browsers render the page correctly by indicating the HTML version being used.
!doctype.tip: The <!DOCTYPE> declaration must be the first line of the HTML document. It is not case-sensitive, but it is recommended to use uppercase for consistency.
!doctype.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
<title>Title of the document</title>
</head>
<body>
The content of the document......
</body>
</html>
!doctype.quiz: Which is the tag that tells the browser which version of HTML user used?

h1.title: <h1> Heading Tag
h1.history: The tag defines the most important heading on the page. Search engines use headings to index the structure of your web pages. Always use exactly one h1 per page.
h1.tip: The <h1> tag is used to define the main heading of a webpage. It is important for SEO and accessibility, as it helps search engines and screen readers understand the content hierarchy.
h1.code:
Hello World

Welcome to Tag Web! Start learning code.
h1.quiz: Which tag creates the highest level system document heading hierarchy?

p.title: Paragraph Tag
p.tip:
Paragraph tag is used to write some paragraph in a web page or HTML. Avoid nesting structural block elements inside

.

b.title: <b> Bold Tag
b.tip: The <b> tag is used to make text bold. However, it does not convey any extra importance or emphasis. For semantic emphasis, consider using the <strong> tag instead.
b.quiz: Which tag is used to make text bold?

a.title: <a> Anchor tag
a.history: Used to navigate other files or pages
a.tip: The <a> tag is used to create hyperlinks. The href attribute specifies the URL of the page the link goes to.
a.code:
This is Anchor tag

Go to Google
a.quiz: Which tag is used to navigate other files or pages?

nav.title: <nav> Navigation Bar
nav.history: Navigation bars are typically located at the top or at the side of a webpage.
nav.tip: The <nav> tag is used to define a section of a webpage that contains navigation links.
nav.quiz: Which tag is used to define a section of a webpage that contains navigation links.?

href.title: href Attribute
href.history: It specifies the destination URL (Uniform Resource Locator) or the path to the resource that the hyperlink points to.
href.tip: The href attribute is used to specify the URL of the page the link goes to.
href.quiz: Which attribute is used to insert some links.?

target.title: target Attribute
target.history: It jumps the link into new webpage without opening the link in the same page
target.tip: The target attribute is used to specify where to open the linked document.
target.quiz: Which attribute is used to open a link of a webpage or anyother in new blank file.?

ul.title: <ul> Unordered List
ul.tip: The <ul> tag is used to create unordered lists.
ul.quiz: Which tag is used for unordered list?

ol.title: <ol> Ordered List
ol.tip: The <ol> tag is used to create ordered lists.
ol.quiz: Which tag is used for numbered list?

li.title: <li> List Item
li.tip: The <li> tag is used to define a list item.
li.quiz: Which tag defines a list item?

dl.title: <dl> Description List
dl.history: Used for a list of terms and their descriptions
dl.tip: The <dl> tag is used to create a description list.
dl.quiz: Which tag is used for description lists?

dt.title: <dt> Description Term
dt.history: Defines a term in a description list
dt.tip: The <dt> tag is used to define a term in a description list.
dt.quiz: Which tag defines the term in a description list?

dd.title: <dd> Description Definition
dd.history: Defines the description or value of a term in a description list
dd.tip: The <dd> tag is used to define the description or value of a term in a description list.
dd.quiz: Which tag defines the description in a description list?

form.title: <form> Form Container
form.tip: The <form> tag is used to create an HTML form for user input.

input.title: <input> Input Field
input.tip: The <input> tag is used to create interactive controls for web-based forms to accept data from the user.
input.quiz: Which tag is used for input fields?

audio.title: <audio> Audio Tag
audio.history: Introduced in HTML5, used to embed audio files with optional controls.
audio.tip: The <audio> tag is used to embed audio content in a webpage. It can include controls for play, pause, and volume.
audio.code:
<audio controls>
  <source src='assets/Believer.mp3' type='audio/mpeg'>
  Your browser does not support the audio element.
</audio>
audio.quiz: Which tag is used to embed audio in HTML?

img.title: Image
img.tip: The tag is used to embed an image in an HTML page. The src attribute specifies the path to the image file.
img.quiz: Which tag is used to show image?

header.title: <header> Header Tag
header.history: Defines a container for introductory content or navigation links in HTML.
header.tip: The <header> tag is used to define the header of a webpage. It typically contains the website's title, navigation links, or other introductory content.
header.quiz: Which tag is used to define the top section of a webpage?

footer.title: <footer> Footer Tag
footer.history: Defines a container for footer content like author info, copyright, or links.
footer.tip: The <footer> tag is used to define the footer of a webpage. It typically contains copyright information, author info, or other supplementary content.
footer.code:
© 2025 My Website. All rights reserved.

Privacy Policy
footer.quiz: Which tag is used to define the bottom section of a webpage?

table.title: <table> Table Tag
table.history: Defines a table structure in HTML.
table.tip: The <table> tag is used to create an HTML table.
table.quiz: Which tag defines a table in HTML?

caption.title: <caption> Table Caption Tag
caption.history: Defines a title or caption for a table.
caption.tip: The <caption> tag is used to define a caption for a table.
caption.quiz: Which tag defines a title for a table?

thead.title: <thead> Table Head Tag
thead.history: Groups the header content in a table.
thead.tip: The <thead> tag is used to group the header content in a table.
thead.quiz: Which tag groups the header rows in a table?

tbody.title: <tbody> Table Body Tag
tbody.history: Groups the main body content in a table.
tbody.tip: The <tbody> tag is used to group the main body content in a table.
tbody.quiz: Which tag groups the main body rows in a table?

tfoot.title: <tfoot> Table Footer Tag
tfoot.history: Groups the footer content in a table, often for totals.
tfoot.tip: The <tfoot> tag is used to group the footer content in a table.
tfoot.quiz: Which tag groups the footer rows in a table?

tr.title: <tr> Table Row Tag
tr.history: Defines a row of cells in a table.
tr.tip: The <tr> tag is used to define a row in a table.
tr.quiz: Which tag defines a row in a table?

td.title: <td> Table Data Cell Tag
td.history: Defines a standard data cell in a table.
td.tip: The <td> tag is used to define a data cell in a table.
td.quiz: Which tag defines a data cell in a table?

th.title: <th> Table Header Cell Tag
th.history: Defines a header cell in a table.
th.tip: The <th> tag is used to define a header cell in a table.
th.quiz: Which tag defines a header cell in a table?

colgroup.title: <colgroup> Column Group Tag
colgroup.history: Defines a group of columns in a table for styling.
colgroup.tip: The <colgroup> tag is used to group columns in a table.
colgroup.quiz: Which tag groups columns in a table?

col.title: <col> Column Tag
col.tip: The <col> tag is used to define properties for a single column.
col.quiz: Which tag defines properties for a single column?

cite.title: <cite> Citation Tag
cite.history: Used to define the title of a creative work (book, website, movie, etc.).
cite.tip: The <cite> tag is used to define the title of a creative work.
cite.quiz: Which tag is used to define the title of a creative work?

q.title: <q> Inline Quote Tag
q.history: Used for short inline quotations inside a paragraph.
q.tip: The <q> tag is used for inline quotations.
q.quiz: Which tag is used for inline quotations?

blockquote.title: <blockquote> Block Quote Tag
blockquote.history: Used for longer quotations that are displayed as separate blocks.
blockquote.tip: The <>blockquote> tag is used for block-level quotations.
blockquote.code: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
blockquote.quiz: Which tag is used for block-level quotations?
